_doc: Ảnh vẽ bằng Gemini cho các từ TRỪU TƯỢNG mà sách và máy tìm kiếm đều chịu thua. Sinh ảnh KHÔNG tất định: cùng prompt hai lần ra hai ảnh khác nhau, nên sha1 ở đây chỉ để phát hiện file bị đổi, khác với crops.json (cắt từ PDF, tất định từng byte). `model` ở gốc là mặc định cho ảnh MỚI; `model` trong từng từ ghi cái đã thật sự dùng. Rẻ nhất: lite + 1K + --batch = $0,017/ảnh. Sinh lại: scripts/gen_words.py mk cie-science-1 --batch
style: Simple friendly flat illustration for a 6-year-old science book. Bright clear colours, plain white background, one single clear subject, thick simple shapes, no words, no letters, no numbers anywhere in the picture.

label.prompt: A simple drawing of a plant with three blank paper tags tied by short strings to its flower, its leaf and its roots, each tag empty and ready to be written on

material.prompt: Four everyday objects in a row on a white surface: a wooden spoon, a metal fork, a clear glass jar and a plastic bottle, showing that things are made of different stuff

explosive.prompt: A rocky hillside quarry with a burst of grey dust and small rock pieces flying up from a blast, seen from a safe distance

protect.prompt: A young tree seedling with a small wooden fence built around it to keep it safe, in a garden

clues.prompt: A green leaf with round holes chewed in it lying on soil, next to a few small animal footprints, showing signs an animal has been here

pretend.prompt: A happy child wearing a paper frog mask and hopping like a frog in a room, clearly playing make believe

local.prompt: A friendly street of a few houses with a small park, trees and a playground nearby, the kind of place a child lives in

describe.prompt: A child pointing at a big red round ball and talking to a friend, with an empty speech bubble above the child's head
